title: Phase 5 / E02: Binding Component Factorial Ablation (2^4) Protocol
primary_question: Which components of the inference context binding (projection_digest, request_envelope_digest, consumed_thss, reported_model_id) are strictly necessary to maintain Exact-Disclosure Admission (GRWC) under targeted adversarial perturbations?
unit_of_analysis: One ablated inference context binding configuration evaluated across an adversarial schedule family under transactional isolation.

primary_endpoints.name: Incremental Invalid-Admission Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: Delta P(Admit | Arm_k) relative to full GRWC baseline upon component removal.

secondary_endpoints.name: Clean Control Admissibility Preservation
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of clean control schedules admitted per active arm.

sample_size.unit_definition: 352 unique schedules replayed across 8 active factorial arms

statistical_plan.method: 2^4 Full Factorial Design & McNemar Matched-Pairs Test

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: A component is deemed necessary if removing it permits invalid admission while clean controls pass.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Incomplete factorial cells fail the ablation audit.
